full_prompt_en: A square stylized landscape painting shows a turquoise lake extending between sculpted blue hills, with tall orange trees on the near shore. The view opens from a dark rounded foreground bank at the lower right toward a narrow water passage in the middle distance. Long horizontal strokes in teal and aquamarine make the lake calm, while its far edge disappears into layers of blue-green slopes. On the left, several small orange trees stand across the water as thin upright accents. Closer to the viewer on the right, a cluster of taller tapering trees rises in ochre, gold, and burnt orange; their smooth elongated crowns contrast with deep navy trunks and shadows. Behind them, the hills curve upward in broad cyan, cobalt, slate, and cream bands, each contour following the land like a carved ribbon. The upper third is crowded with large pale cream clouds, their rounded volumes built from closely spaced curved strokes. A brighter circular cloud mass hovers near the upper center, adding a sunlit focus without a sharply drawn sun. The geometry is simplified but not flat: overlapping bands and shifts from saturated foreground to pale distance establish clear depth. The paint appears evenly worked with fine directional texture, matte color, and crisp boundaries between major shapes. Light spreads across the scene from above, warming the clouds and orange crowns while the lower banks stay cooler and darker. No figures or text appear. The overall composition is serene and monumental, balancing vertical warm accents against flowing blue water, layered hills, and billowing cream forms.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形风格化风景画描绘一片绿松石色湖泊伸入雕塑般的蓝色山丘之间，近岸立着高高的橙色树木。视线从右下方深色圆形前岸打开，通向中景狭窄的水道。蓝绿与海蓝色长水平笔触让湖面平静，远岸消失在层层蓝绿坡地里。左侧，几棵小橙树立在水对岸，形成细竖向强调。更靠近观者的右侧，一簇高而渐尖的树以赭黄、金色和焦橙升起，平滑细长树冠与深海军蓝树干及阴影相对。其后，丘陵以青、钴蓝、石板色和奶油色宽阔色带向上弯曲，每条轮廓都像雕刻丝带一样顺着地势。上三分之一挤满大型浅奶油云，其圆润体积由紧密弯曲笔触构成。一个更亮的圆形云团悬在上方中央附近，提供阳光焦点，却没有明确画出太阳。几何形简化但并不平板：重叠色带，以及从饱和前景到浅色远方的变化，建立清楚纵深。颜料以细定向肌理均匀加工，哑光色彩和主要形状间的清晰边界鲜明。光从上方洒满场景，温暖云层和橙树冠，下方岸坡保持冷而深。没有人物或文字。整体构图宁静且壮阔，以暖色竖向强调平衡流动蓝水、层叠山丘和鼓起的奶油色云。
style_prompt_en: Stylized landscape painting simplifies natural masses into sculpted curves, layered color bands, and slender upright accents. Turquoise, cobalt, slate blue, cream, ochre, and burnt orange create a deliberate cool-warm balance. Fine directional brush texture follows each rounded plane, while major boundaries stay crisp and matte. Light is broad and high, warming pale upper surfaces and letting lower blue shapes retain saturated shadow. Repeated sweeping contours lead the eye into depth without small realistic detail. The overall effect is serene, monumental, and rhythmically decorative.
style_prompt_zh: 风格化风景绘画把自然色团简化成雕塑般曲面、层叠色带和细长竖向强调。绿松石、钴蓝、石板蓝、奶油、赭黄和焦橙构成有意的冷暖平衡。细定向笔触肌理顺着每个圆弧平面走，主要边界保持清晰哑光。光宽阔且来自高处，温暖上方浅表面，让下方蓝形保留饱和阴影。重复扫弧轮廓引导视线进入纵深，不依赖写实微细节。整体宁静、壮阔，装饰节奏鲜明。
theme_en: A turquoise lake among sculpted blue hills and tall orange trees
theme_zh: 绿松石色湖泊环绕雕塑般蓝色山丘与高橙色树木
name: Lawren Harris
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
